live.label: Live now
live.nothingRunning: Nobody is playing right now. Press Play now to start a game.

hero.title: Village wars in your browser
hero.subhead: One hour, up to {instantSeats} players and {instantBots} bots. You start with {instantStartAxe} axemen, {instantStartLightCav} light cavalry and a hetman. Hold {instantDominationPct}% of the villages and the game ends early.
hero.reassure: No sign-up. Works on your phone.
hero.clipAlt: The game: a village at work, then an army marching across the map
hero.account: An account adds long worlds and private games for your friends.

village.title: Village
village.text: Buildings, resources and the build queue.
village.alt: The village with two upgrades in the build queue

army.title: Army
army.text: Train troops, then send attacks and support from the rally point.
army.alt: The rally point on a phone

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: A report after every battle, with losses and loot.

incoming.title: Incoming attacks
incoming.text: You see when an attack lands, in time to send support.

payToWin.a: No. If anything is ever sold, it will be looks or small extras such as a fancier profile editor. Never resources, speed or troops.

bots.a: Yes, and they are always marked as bots. A one-hour game has up to {instantSeats} players and {instantBots} bots.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone?
phone.a: Yes. The game runs in the browser of a phone, a tablet or a computer; there is nothing to install.

time.q: How much time does it take?
time.a: A quick game takes {instantDurationMin} minutes. A long world needs a few short visits a day.
